title: Spanish Spaghetti Pasta
description: A simple Spanish-inspired spaghetti dish with the flavors of the Mediterranean.

ingredients.name: Olive oil
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality extra virgin olive oil

instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook spaghetti according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat olive oil over medium heat. Add minced garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Add diced tomato to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes, or until it starts to break down.
Add red pepper flakes (if using) to the skillet and stir to combine.
When the spaghetti is done cooking, drain it and add it to the skillet with the tomato mixture.
Toss the spaghetti in the skillet to combine, seasoning with salt and black pepper to taste.
